system.description:
At 6th level, you choose one of the following options based on your preferred method of opposing pollution and environmental destruction.

Destructive Force

Your natural weapons gain the Breaker property and deal double damage to unattended objects. If you use planted explosives to deal damage to unattended objects, you also deal double damage to them.

Foiled by Foliage

As an action, you can take control of a nonsapient plant. Doing so temporarily grants the plant motility and your Narrator will assign awakened plant statistics, such as awakened shrub or awakened tree. The plant shares your initiative and can move each round at your telepathic command. By spending a bonus action on your turn, you can telepathically command the plant to take an action. This effect has a range of 60ft and a duration of 10 minutes with concentration, though during the duration you can shift your control to another nonsapient plant as an action on your turn, causing the first to return to its normal state. You can use this ability once per short or long rest.

Poison and Pollution

You gain resistance to Poison damage and advantage on saving throws against Disease or Poison effects. In addition, you can use a bonus action to envenom your weapons. Doing so causes your next successful attack before the start of your next turn to deal 1d4 ongoing poison damage for up to 1 minute. You may use this ability a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier and recover all uses at the end of a short or long rest.
